'''Tsuge Yamaguchi Shrine''' (都祁山口神社) refers to Shinto shrines in the {{ill|Yamato Province|en|Yamato Province|qid=Q907495|lt=Yamato Province}}'s [[Yamabe District]].

* {{ill|Tsuge Yamaguchi Shrine (Nara)|ja|都祁山口神社 (奈良市)}} - Located in [[:en:Nara City|Nara City]], {{ill|Nara Prefecture|en|Nara Prefecture|qid=Q131287|lt=Nara Prefecture}}, in the Tsuge Koyamado area.
* {{ill|Tsuge Yamaguchi Shrine (Tenri)|ja|都祁山口神社 (天理市)}} - Located in [[:en:Tenri|Tenri]], Nara Prefecture, in the Somanouchi area.
